entry.name: mc.log~
entry.description: Use the log~ object to output a signal composed of the logarithms of its input values. You can specify the logarithmic base.

arguments.name: logarithmic-base
arguments.description: Sets the base of the logarithm. The default value is 0.

messages.name: float
messages.digest: Set the base of the logarithm
messages.description: In right inlet: Sets the base of the logarithm. The default is 0, which is equivalent to the natural logarithm (log to the base e, or 2.71828182). log to the base of 1 is always 0.

messages.name: signal
messages.description: In left inlet:sends out a signal that is the logarithm of the input signal, to the base specified by the typed-in argument or the value most recently received in the right inlet. If a value in the signal is less than or equal to 0,sends out a value of 0.00000001.
